sentence: This project studies the chemical processes involved in making metal nanoparticles that contain a mixture of different metals.
This project builds a catalog of active galactic nuclei to learn how supermassive black holes grow and how galaxies evolve.
This project tries to build gene editing tools that change plant DNA accurately and efficiently in rice, tomato, and poplar.
This project uses machine learning to find molecules that bind to a group of proteins called G protein-coupled receptors.
This project studies jumping genes and the enzymes they carry that use guide RNAs to cut matching DNA.
This project studies how to get around the resolution limits of imaging systems such as telescopes, microscopes, and cameras.
This project studies how sound waves move through a tailor-made two-dimensional medium with nanoscale cavities covered by a membrane.
This project uses artificial intelligence and computational techniques to build an eye-imaging system that captures a larger area in less time.
This project studies how protons and neutrons interact in rare isotopes that have far more neutrons than protons.
This project uses computational tools to find out how metal catalysts and hydrogen gas break down polyethylene into smaller chemicals.
This project builds software that helps scientists share and analyze data for reconstructing evolutionary trees of living and extinct species.
This project tests whether beaver dam analogs help urban streams handle stormwater, flooding, and pollution.
This project builds mathematical methods that use machine learning to sort Alzheimer's disease into different subtypes from genetic, protein, and brain imaging data.
This project tests whether buildings and living things both form their shapes through a network that connects the system with its environment.
This project studies which genes change color patterns in bumble bees and whether different species use the same genes.
This project tests whether imaging and audio monitoring can measure how engaged people are in virtual classes without bothering them.
This project builds a machine learning framework that models multiscale phenomena using data from experiments and computer simulations.
This project designs ways to detect and estimate quantum signals for quantum sensing and quantum communication.
